title: Forest villagers protest tourism curbs after tiger translocation

ai.summary: Forest villagers in West Bengal protested tourism restrictions imposed by the forest department to allow a translocated tiger to acclimatize, claiming the restrictions threaten their livelihoods as they rely on tourism for income.

facts.claim: Forest villagers protested restrictions on tourism activities imposed to minimise disturbance and allow the tigress to acclimatise
facts.quote: Forest villagers protested restrictions on tourism activities imposed to minimise disturbance and allow the tigress to acclimatise

facts.claim: The tiger recovery programme, planned over a decade ago, involved habitat restoration and prey-base improvement
facts.quote: The tiger recovery programme, planned over a decade ago, involved habitat restoration and prey-base improvement

facts.claim: A three year old tigress, T138 was released in Buxa Tiger Reserve in West Bengal on October 2
facts.quote: A three year old tigress, T138 was released in Buxa Tiger Reserve in West Bengal on October 2

facts.claim: The translocation was the result of a joint initiative of the West Bengal Forest Department and National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA)
facts.quote: The translocation was the result of a joint initiative of the West Bengal Forest Department and National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA)

facts.claim: Bhupender Yadav, Union Cabinet Minister for Forest, Environment and Climate Change celebrated the tiger reintroduction to Buxa on his social media
facts.quote: Bhupender Yadav, Union Cabinet Minister for Forest, Environment and Climate Change celebrated the tiger reintroduction to Buxa on his social media

facts.claim: Chief Wildlife Warden of West Bengal, Pradeep Vyas shared that the gradual disappearance of tigers in Buxa Tiger Reserve (BTR) started from 1970 onwards
facts.quote: Chief Wildlife Warden of West Bengal, Pradeep Vyas shared that the gradual disappearance of tigers in Buxa Tiger Reserve (BTR) started from 1970 onwards

facts.claim: The restriction has been imposed as a part of a standard protocol to provide an undisturbed habitat to the reintroduced tiger to get acclimatised to the new environment
facts.quote: We have restricted tourism so that it doesn’t get disturbed and venture outside the forest

facts.claim: Ayan Naidu, executive member of Maha Gram Sabha Joutha Sangram Committee, the organisation leading the protest said that while they were happy about the reintroduction since Buxa has not had a tiger in two decades, they were worried about loss of livelihood due to restrictions
facts.quote: I live in Jayanti village and there is no scope for any other employment except tourism. Agriculture is not possible here because of the terrain. So this restriction is affecting the livelihood of more than 10,000 people here.

We want the removal of Rajabhatkhawa toll gate where we have to pay ₹480 per vehicle plus ₹150 per person on a PWD road. This is harassment as we have to go to the nearest town, Alipurduar, 30 km away, for everything. We also seek implementation of Forest Rights Act (FRA), 2006 and declaration of forest settlements as revenue villages.

ai.background_note: Forest villagers in 18 forest villages of Buxa Tiger Reserve protested tourism restrictions imposed by the forest department to allow a translocated tiger to acclimatize, claiming the restrictions threaten their livelihoods as they rely on tourism for income.
